About matching & export

Signature protection: always on. PDFs with detected digital signatures open in view-only mode. Download returns the original file unchanged. This editor does not verify certificate trust or signature validity.

Font names and sizes come from the PDF. Bold and italic are inferred from font names; underline and paragraph structure are not reliably encoded.

Load the original font for the closest match. Embedded subset fonts may lack new characters.

Exports preserve native text, graphics and existing images. Edited text stays selectable; pages are never converted to images.

Watermarks and artwork remain in their original PDF structure. Check the export before sharing. Edits can be detected and may invalidate signatures.

Export size depends on the original content and any fonts you add. Previously rasterized PDFs remain images; reopen the original PDF to keep its text.

Ready to open a PDFClick text to type · Drag blue handle to move · Ctrl/Cmd+Z to undo

Sign a new copy

Your certificate and password stay in this browser. Signing adds a record page identifying the new signer. Existing signed PDFs remain protected.

Choose a certificate to see the signing identity.

RSA 2048+ only. Certificate trust and revocation are not checked. Signing time uses your device clock; no trusted timestamp is included.

File fingerprints

SHA-256 and SHA-512 identify exact file bytes. A hash alone does not prove issuer identity. The current export includes applied edits.

Choose which file to fingerprint.
